The project consisted of designing and implementing a public consultation process for the conservation and management program of the protected area: Mexican Caribbean Biosphere Reserve for the National Commission of Protected Areas (CONANP). This process included a web-based platform for interactive visualization and for systematizing the opinions registered by citizens.
